Dr. Lee is the owner and chiropractor at the Cathedraltown Health Clinic. Located in the community of Cathedraltown in Markham, Ontario. With his experience in chiropractic and acupuncture, his purpose is to educate and help individuals of all walks of life reach a level of health and wellness through chiropractic and acupuncture care. 

For more information please go to: www.cathedraltownhealth.com
